data.name: Masked Talents
data.description: The masked performer gains a rogue talent from the following list: expert leaper, fast stealth, ledge walker, rogue crawl, rope master, stand up, and wall scramble.

raw_tokens.value: The masked performer gains a rogue talent from the following list: expert leaper, fast stealth, ledge walker, rogue crawl, rope master, stand up, and wall scramble.

The masked performer can choose a second rogue talent from any of the above talents or an advanced talent from the following list: defensive roll, fast tumble, hide in plain sight, and skill mastery.|PRECLASS:1,Bard=17
This ability does not qualify her for the Extra Rogue Talent feat.
